# GNSS Tracker (GalileoHack) 🛰️
Winner of HackUPC 2024 ESA Challenge. 🏆

An Android application that allows you to retrieve and compare data from different GNSS satellite constellations, as well as understand how your location is calculated.

- See all satellites received by your phone
- Compare satellites by their origin (GALILEO, GPS, QZSS, etc.)
- Compare your GNSS (satellite) based location with your network based location
